src.bungie: This weapon fires a Harvester Spike projectile. Dealing final blows with this weapon creates a single Vestige at the target's location. Impaling more powerful combatants with the projectile creates a steady stream of Vestiges from the target.
src.clarity:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.
Deals 40% increased damage against Minor Combatants (Exotic Primary bonus is typically 30%).
Fires a micro-missile-like projectile that explodes in a 5 meter radius. Kills create a Vestige that travels up to 40 meters towards you.
Shots fired into Champions, Minibosses, or Bosses impale them, damaging them once every 0.8 seconds for 4 seconds and creating a Vestige on each tick (6 Vestiges total).
Impaled Spikes can be stacked.
src.compendium:
Stasis Micro-Missile Grenade Launcher Rifle
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. Deals 40% increased damage against Rank-and-File Combatants (compared to Exotic Primary's 30%)
Fires Harvester Spikes in a straight line, dealing 43 [39] Impact Damage, and up to 697 [91] Explosive Damage, down to 30% damage over 5 meters.
Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses become impaled on direct hits, being dealt 79 Damage every 0.8 seconds up to 6 times over 4 seconds. 
Impaled Enemies trigger the Harvester Spike Explosion on the sixth tick, removing the impaled projectile.
Impale Damage is non-lethal. There is no limit to the amount of simultaneous impales on a single enemy.
Kills create a floating Vestige that home in towards the user. Picking up a Vestige grants Vestigial Alchemy Energy.
Picking up 7 Vestiges totals 50% Vestige Energy. Requires an additional 10 Vestiges (17 Total) to reach 100% Energy.
Impaled Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses spawn a Vestige every time Impale damage ticks, spawning up to 6 Vestiges on a single shot.
Holding [Reload] while Vestigial Alchemy is at least at 50% Energy toggles between Firing Modes.
50%–99% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode | 100% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode -> Heavy Ammo Mode
Ammo-Loaded Shots deplete Vestigial Alchemy Energy, and always explode on hit, meaning they cannot impale Combatants.
Special Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Special Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 50% Vestigial Energy.
Special Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.
Heavy Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 100% Vestigial Energy.
Heavy Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.
↑Catalyst:
Grants the One For All trait.

src.bungie:
This weapon gains energy when you pick up Vestiges and allows you to create ammo at the projectile impact point for you and your allies. Special ammo mode unlocks at 50% energy, while Heavy ammo mode unlocks at 100% energy. 

To transform Vestiges into Special ammo, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to activate Special ammo mode. [Alternate Weapon Action]  a second time to activate Heavy ammo mode.
src.clarity:
Vestiges collected by Harvester Spikes charge up 'Vestigial Alchemy'.
After collecting 7 Vestiges (50% charge):
Enables a Hold [Reload] interaction that makes your next shot fired spawn a Special Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies, granting 10% of your Total Special Ammo Reserves
After collecting 17 Vestiges (100% charge):
Allows you to cycle Hold [Reload] a second time, making your next shot fired spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick at the point of impact for you and your allies on impact, granting 10% of your Total Heavy Ammo Reserves
Creating ammo bricks consumes the energy it cost to reach that level on the meter. Ammo-Spawning spikes cannot impale targets.

src.bungie: Grenades stick to surfaces and chain Arc bolts to other mines.
src.clarity:
Grenades fired are Arc Traps that lay inactive for 30 seconds and connect to other bolts within 15 meters. Up to 6 Arc Traps can exist at a time.
Enemies within 2 meters of a trap activate all linked traps. Activated traps deal damage once every 0.5 seconds and detonate after 10 seconds.
Unlinked Arc Bolts deal damage in a 4 meter radius after detecting an enemy within 5 meters. Linked Arc Bolts only damage enemies touching the tripwire.
Traps that are linked together deal 100% bonus tick damage (compared to a single bolt).
src.compendium:
Arc Rapid-Fire Trap Grenade Launcher
Fires Arc Bolts that stick to surfaces or enemies for up to 30 seconds. Up to 6 Arc Bolts can be simultaneously placed per Guardian.
Bolts that are within 15 metres of others will create an electrified tripwire between each linked bolt.
 Arc Bolts that are linked will all simultaneously trigger.
Bolts will not link to an ally's Anarchy Bolts.
Arc Bolts:
Deal ticks of 218 [35] damage every 0.5 seconds, down to 30% damage over a 4 meter radius for 10 seconds once triggered by detecting an enemy within 5 meters.
Linked Arc Bolts deal 435 [?] damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies touching the tripwire. Linked Arc Bolts only damage enemies in the tripwires.
Explode after 10 seconds of being triggered, or upon expiring, dealing 223 [40] damage, down to 50% damage over 4 meters.
Bolts created by allies do not interfere with damage, allowing each Guardian to deal their own independent damage.
↑Catalyst: Grants the Jolting Feedback trait.
Jolts on the 4th damage instance, 3 if Amplified.

src.bungie: This weapon generates blight as it deals damage. While not firing, blight depletes, and the magazine is gradually refilled. Reload the weapon to convert stored blight into Blighted Seekers.
src.clarity:
Magazine is refilled every 0.2 seconds based on currently remaining ammo while not firing the weapon.
Refill amount by currently remaining ammo:
• 1-2 Ammo: 4 shots
• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots
• 9-16 Ammo: 2 shots
• 17 Ammo: 1 shot
Generates 2% Blight per hit. Not firing for 1.3 seconds drains 3.33% Blight every 1.2 seconds.
Performing a manual reload creates Blighted Seekers for 7 seconds, granting 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight converted. Maximum of 6 Seekers. Blight always rounds up to the next full Seeker.
Grants ? Reload Speed based on the amount of Blighted Seekers prepared.
Blighted Seekers are fired at 720 RPM while aiming down sights or 450 RPM if fired from the hip.

src.bungie: Sprinting, sliding, and firing this weapon builds a temporary electrostatic charge, increasing range and reload speed. Final blows with high charge cause explosions, and maximum charge explosions blind targets.
src.clarity:
Sprinting, sliding, or firing increases the Overcharge Capacitor based on the action performed:
• Sliding grants 10% progress
• Sprinting for 0.25 seconds grants 20% progress per second
• Shooting for 0.267 seconds grants 20% progress per second
Overcharge Capacitor linearly? grants the following benefits based on progress:
• ? Range
• ? Reload Speed
At above 40% charge, kills cause enemies to explode for 95 [76] damage and apply Blind for 10 seconds in a 7 meter radius. At 100% charge, the explosions deal 189 [?] damage and Blind for 10 seconds in an 8 meter radius.
Overcharge Capacitor decays at a rate of 33% per second after 1.1 seconds of not being built. Performing a manual reload resets your charge to 0%.
src.compendium:
Arc Precision Auto Rifle
Refills 10% Ammo every 0.34 seconds while sprinting.
Sprinting, sliding, and shooting builds up charge, granting up to +? Range and +? Reload Speed. 
Shooting = +20%/s after firing 3 rounds automatically | Sliding = +10% Charge per slide.
Sprinting = +20% Charge/s after a 0.25 second delay. Movement Speed must be above ~6m/s to build up charge.
Charge decays at a rate of -33% per second after not doing any of those actions for 1.1 seconds. Manual Reloads instantly empty the charge.
Kills while at ≥40% Charge cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 95 [76] Damage, down to 30% damage, and blind enemies for 10 seconds in a 7 meter radius.
Explosions triggered while at 100% Charge deal 189 [?] Damage, down to 40% damage, and blind enemies for 10 seconds in a 8 meter radius.
↑Static Buildup:
Passively generates 7% Charge per second and removes Passive Decay while Amplified.
 Passive Charge is additive to Active Charge. Manual Reloads still empty the charge.

src.bungie: Shoots erratic bullets from all gun barrels at the same time.
src.clarity:
Fires 3 evenly spread pellets around the center pellet in an alternating triangle pattern for each shot. The central pellet always stays within the accuracy cone around your reticle.
Pellets experience 'reverse range falloff' at close-mid range and deal less damage the closer you are to the target: Deal 16.67% decreased damage at point-blank, scaling up to base damage at 14 meters (22.4 when ADS).
Beyond ~30 meters (~53 when ADS), damage starts experiencing regular falloff.
src.compendium:
Kinetic Quad-Barrel High-Impact Auto Rifle
Deals 85% of the damage of a High-Impact Auto Rifle.
Has reverse damage falloff at close ranges for both firing modes. Deals 75% decreased damage to Stasis Crystals.
Each shot fires 4 evenly spread pellets in a triangular shape, with one always landing within the Accuracy Cone.
Each pellet deals up to 44 [20.4] damage with a 1.77x Precision Multiplier.
ADS grants -25% Pellet Spread.
Decreases damage dealt the closer an enemy is, up to a maximum of 16.67% Decreased Damage at point blank, scaling up to base damage at 14 metres. 
The ADS Damage Falloff Scalar of 1.6x increases the minimum distance to reach base damage to 22 meters.
↑Focused Fire: Hold [Reload] within 7 seconds of a kill to activate Focused Fire. Green Light displays when it's possible to swap firing modes.
50% [10%] increased damage and -30% Pellet Spread for 7 seconds.
Additional Weapon Kills while Focused Fire is active refresh its duration.
Focused Fire and Trigger Condition are removed on stow.

At 100% Beam Energy, hits spawn an Ionic Trace.
2 second cooldown between spawns.
src.compendium:
Arc Adaptive Trace Rifle
Steadily grants up to 80% increased damage as Energy is accumulated.
All energy is removed over 0.2 seconds after not generating energy for 1.05 seconds.
Upon dealing damage:

Passively grants +20 Stability, +20 Reload Speed, and the Supercharged Magazine trait.

src.bungie: This weapon stores Void debuffs when damaging foes, leeching them directly when the target is suppressed, weakened, or volatile. Once charged, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to cause damage from this weapon and to apply the stored debuffs.
src.clarity:
Dealing damage charges 'Void Leech Mode'.
Scoring 27 Weapon Hits:
• Charges one currently uncharged Void Debuff
• Uncharged debuffs are granted in the following order: Volatile 🠚 Weaken 🠚 Suppression
Scoring 6 Weapon Hits on a Void debuffed target, or having a Void debuff applied to you by an enemy, instantly leeches that debuff into your gun.
Both hit counters can progress simultaneously (E.g.: Leeching Weaken off a target also counts as 6 hits toward charging Volatile).
Leeching any Void Debuff off a target, or having all three Void Debuffs charged, enables you to hold [Reload] and activate 'Void Leech' for 15 [10] seconds.
Void Leech mode grants 20% increased damage and appplies all stored Void Debuffs on hit.
src.compendium:
Void Adaptive Pulse Rifle
Scoring 27 hits leeches Void Debuffs in the order of Volatile -> Weaken -> Suppression. 
Scoring a hit against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs, or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly leeches said debuffs for Void Leech Mode.
Void Leech Mode:
Scoring a hit charges 1.3% Energy (76 hits). Hits against Void-Debuffed Enemies charge 16.7% Energy (6 hits). 
Scoring a kill against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly charges Void Leech Mode.
Leeched Void Debuffs persist through stow. Void Leech Mode cannot be charged by self-applied debuffs.
Once charged, hold [Reload] to activate Void Leech for 15 [10] seconds.
Hits will inflict the Void Debuffs that were leeched and grants 20% increased damage.
Receiving Void Buffs refills Magazine. Reactivating Devour through kills also refills the magazine.
↑Catalyst: Grants the Repulsor Brace trait.

src.bungie: Final blows or rapid hits with this weapon's frontal blades heal you and provide Soulfire Charges, which cause rounds fired by this weapon to inflict potent corruption. These frontal blades deal increased damage to targets afflicted by corruption.
src.clarity:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.
Landing two Frontal Blade hits within 2 seconds of each other, or scoring a Frontal Blade kill, heals you for 40 HP and grants one stack of 'Soulfire Charge'. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Firing this weapon consumes one stack of Soulfire Charge to apply Potent Corruption (poison) that increases in DOT over time.
Potent Corruption deals 65 [?] Kinetic damage once every 0.5 seconds for 10 seconds, ramping up in damage by 8.7% for each tick over 20 ticks, ending at 300 [?] damage on the final tick. In total, one application of Potent Corruption deals 2,985 [?] damage.
Frontal Blades deal 50% increased melee damage against corrupted (poisoned) enemies.
src.compendium:
Kinetic Aggressive Fusion Rifle
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow. 
The last Exotic Weapon added to Destiny 2.
Replaces Melee Ability with the weapon's Frontal Blades capable of performing a swift two-hit combo with an extended 7 meter lunge.
Each strike deals ? [84] Kinetic Damage. Frontal Blades deal 50% increased Melee Damage on Corrupted Enemies.
Frontal Blade Damage scales with Melee Stat and Melee Damage Buffs. It is NOT a Glaive Melee.
Upon scoring 2 Frontal Blade Strikes within 2? seconds of each or a Frontal Blade Kill:
Grants a stack of Soulfire Charges, up to a maximum of 6 stacks and restores 40 HP.
Stacks are only consumed upon firing or on death.
Fires an increasingly wider 3 round burst of 4 projectiles each.
Projectiles deal 143 [?] Kinetic Damage.
Consumes a stack of Soulfire Charge to inflict Potent Corruption on enemies.
Potent Corruption deals 65 [?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds, ramping up by ~8.7% per tick over 20 ticks, up to a final tick of 300 [?] Damage, totalling 2,985 [?] Damage.
Soulfire Charge's Potent Corruption causes enemies to create a Soulfire Crystal on death.
Soulfire Crystals are Constructs with 400? HP that linger for 15 seconds, exploding upon being reduced to 0 HP.
Soulfire Crystal Explosion deals up to 1,065 [?] Kinetic Damage over 8 meters, down to 75% Damage.
↑Catalyst grants 4 selectable traits:
Soulfire Succor | Destroying Soulfire Crystals with Frontal Blades grants a Soulfire Charge and refills +1 Ammo.
Soulfire Rancor | Soulfire Crystals explode when an enemy is within 7 meters, dealing 5% increased damage and inflicting the aforementioned Potent Corruption.
Soulfire Zeal | Soulfire Crystal Explosions within 15 meters grant maximized movement speed and 20?% Damage Resist for +7 seconds, up to 20 seconds.
Soulfire Skewer | Soulfire Crystal Explosions within 15 meters grant Frontal Blades the ability to inflict Corruption for +7 seconds, up to 20 seconds.
Corruption deals 16 per tick every 0.5 seconds up to 10 times per infliction and can stack.

src.compendium:

Unique Damage Profile similar to Precision Bows that uses Lightweight Draw Curves.

Guidance Ring:
Spawned by firing a fully-drawn hipfired shot while at x3 Guidance Ring Charges.
 Guidance Ring lasts for 20 seconds and rotates to face its owner. Only 3 Guidance Ring may exist at once across all players. Only 1 Ring per user.

Seekers can benefit from Volatile Rounds, Unraveling Rounds, and more!
Hierarchy of Needs releases 3 Seekers, each dealing up to 193 [15?] Damage.
Primary Ammo Bows (Including non-listed Exotics) release 2 Seekers, each dealing up to 138 Weapon-Matching Damage. Ticuu's Hipfire releases 3 Seekers.
Trinity Ghoul = 3 x 179 | Wish-Ender = 2 x 167 | Buried Bloodline = 2 x 120 | Heirloom = 2 x 40

 Displayed Damage Numbers are for the Strand Version.

src.bungie: Final blows with this weapon collapse victims into Void Transmutation spheres.
src.clarity:
Intrinsically deals 40% more PvE damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.
Kills with this weapon's beam turn the target into a Transmutation Sphere. Incurs a 5 second cooldown before another sphere can be created.
Transmutation Spheres are considered a generic 'Void Weapon'. They benefit from Empowering and Void-Verb Buffs, but are unaffected by nor trigger Ability, Trace Rifle, or Weapon Surge effects.
src.compendium:
Void Adaptive Trace Rifle
Intrinsically has a 1.4x PVE Bonus over Legendary Trace Rifles.
Kills collapse enemies into Transmutation Spheres with 30 Ammo. Spheres can remain on the ground for up to 30 seconds. 
Transmutation Spheres are pickupable objects that are able to use Light Attacks, Heavy Attacks, and Guard/Drain. Dropping a Transmutation Sphere immediately despawns it.
Ammo is passively drained at a rate of 1 Ammo Per Second. Attacking or Guarding disables passive drain until the Attack Animation is finished or until no longer Guarding.
Transmutation Spheres:
They are considered Generic Void Weapons, and their damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs, as well as Activity Surges and other generic Void Damage buffs. 
They are also able to inflict Volatile through Volatile Rounds. 
Spheres will not trigger, nor be affected by any effect related to Melee Abilities, Void Abilities, Trace Rifles, or Weapon Surge Mods.
Light Attacks | Lunges forward, dealing 270 [150] damage, disorienting Combatants and consuming 1 Ammo. Airborne Attacks deal 25% decreased damage. Can attack twice every second.
Heavy Attacks | Slams the Sphere onto the ground, detonating it, dealing 1350 [300 Guardians | 1500 Constructs] damage without falloff and inflicting suppression to enemies within 5? metres. 
Damage is unaffected by the Ammo Remaining.
Guarding | Projects a draining field over a ? metre radius, dealing 28 [12] damage and restoring 5 HP per enemy hit every 0.3 seconds.
Grants 80% [50%] Damage Resist and prevents knockback while guarding. Combatants inside the draining field are disoriented.
Ammo Drains at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.25 seconds. The last remaining 3 Ammo drain at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.5 seconds until 1 Ammo is left.
Guarding while at 1 Ammo inflicts Transfiguration, dealing increasingly higher self-damage every 0.7 seconds until no longer Guarding or death. 
Self-Damage inflicted maxes out at 100 damage per tick and ignores all Damage Resist. Will eventually outright kill after enough time.

Upon scoring a Transmutation Sphere Kill or upon damaging a Miniboss+ with a Transmutation Sphere:
30% [15%] increased damage for 7 seconds.

src.bungie: Hitting targets with this weapon builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them, does not expend ammo, and fills this weapon's magazine from reserves. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and spawns Threadlings from your allies.
src.clarity:
Deals 30% more damage than other High Impact Machine Guns.
Scoring hits with the gun grants 10% Healing Charge. (Unlike Support-Frame Auto Rifles, this is the only way to gain charge.)
Hip-fire to shoot Healing Rounds at 600 RPM that seek allies within the reticle. Healing Rounds restore 30 HP per hit and do not consume ammo, instead costing 2% Healing Charge each. Firing a healing round refills 2 rounds into the magazine from reserves.
Landing 6 healing rounds within 1 second of each spawns a Threadling at the ally's location, and grants both you and them 'Support Frame Boost'. Support Frame Boost increases weapon damage by 10% for 6 seconds and stacks with everything.
Healing a Teeming Nest also grants you the Support Frame Boost.
src.compendium:
Strand Support High-Impact Machine Gun
Shares MOST Healing Mechanics with Support Frame Auto Rifles. Threadlings from Rapid Healing and Nests both count as Weapon Damage.
Scoring a hit grants 10% Healing Charge. Does NOT get charge from damage from other sources, nor is it scaled by damage.
Hipfired Healing Shots do not consume ammo, expend 2% Healing Charge to restore 30 HP, and refill 2 Ammo at an increased 600 RPM.
Upon scoring 5 healing hits within 1 second of each on allies or Teeming Nests:
The next healing hits within 1 seconds of each on allies spawns 1 Threadling on them, and applies Support Frame Boost to the user and the targeted ally.
Rapid Healing a Teeming Nest ADDITIONALLY fully restores its health and also triggers Support Frame Boost.
Kills create a Teeming Nest.
Scoring a kill within 30 meters of a Teeming Nest instead spawn a Threadling on Enemy Death Location.
Teeming Nest: 300 Construct HP. Lasts for 17.5 seconds, constantly draining 6.7% (-20) HP per second 1.5 seconds after reaching Full Health.
Gives birth to a Threadling every 5 seconds.
Can be targeted by Service of Luzaku, restoring 11.5% (+1.5s) HP per shot.
↑Disorganized Attachment:
Nests become harvestable after giving birth to a total of 6 Threadlings.
Harvesting a Nest destroys it to grant a Throwable Tangle.

[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Swap to Arc Seeker mode. Arc Seekers track toward combatants you target.
src.clarity:
Hold [Reload] to activate Arc Seeker mode.
Arc Seeker Mode reduces Fire Rate to 100 RPM and shoots tracking bolts that deal 76 [50] damage in a 3 meter radius.
Special Note:
Bolt Charge that is discharged through Arc Seeker hits counts as 'Scout Rifle Weapon Damage' and benefits from all increases that apply to this damage type. This allows the Bolt Charge detonations to scale both with traditional weapon damage buffs (like Radiant and Surges) and with Combatant Scalars.
Furthermore, hits that would discharge Bolt Charge anyway (such as hits behind a Storm's Keep barricade or hits as the caster of a Well of Radiance) cause Bolt Charge to discharge twice, with one buffed as weapon damage and the other being a regular discharge.
This damage increase to Bolt Charge can be further compounded by the Flashover Artifact Mod from the Tablet of Ruin, which adds a multiplicative 50%.

src.bungie: Fusion projectiles attach and detonate with a delayed Void blast.
src.clarity:
Powered Heavy Attacks spawn clusters of 'Telesto Bolts', each dealing 68 or 117 [83] damage.
Telesto Bolt clusters vary by Sword Frame:
• Aggressive: 8 bolts in a clustered spread ahead of you
• Caster: 6 bolts on projectile point of impact
• Lightweight: 7 bolts in a forward arc ahead of you
• Vortex: 10 bolts spread around you
• Wave: 8 bolts at the end of the wave
src.compendium:
Void Sticky Fusion Rifle
Fires 7 sticky, proximity detonated bolts, each dealing up to 236 [47] Void Damage, down to 12.5% damage over 4 meters each.
Bolts last up to 5 seconds on surfaces, automatically detonate once an enemy is within 3 meters, and cannot be destroyed.
Scoring 3 Void Kills within 4.5 seconds of each triggers Harbinger's Pulse, fully refilling Telesto's Magazine.
Telesto Kills count as 2 Kills.
↑Deeper Pockets:
Passively grants +3 Magazine Size (4 -> 7) and +40 Ammo Generation.

Hold [Reload] to smack Telesto, priming Harbinger Seethe once Harbinger's Pulse has been triggered 3 times.
The next direct hit creates a portal over the target that releases 22 Telesto bolts over 2.25 seconds.
Incurs a 14 second cooldown after creating a portal before progress can be made again.

Fires projectiles that detonate upon impacting the floor, dealing up to 172 [51] damage over 6 meters, down to 0% damage, and creating blighted ground on impact.
Blighted Ground lasts for 4.5 seconds and covers a 4.5 metre radius upon landing on the ground.
 Enemies take 86 [40] damage every 0.3 seconds while standing over blighted ground.

Direct hits against Blighted Enemy increases the impact damage to 773 [?] damage.
Blighted Enemies drop a Witherhoard projectile underneath them on death.
Enemies can only simultaneously take damage from directly being Blighted and standing over blighted ground.
Malfeasance and Wish-Ender deal 25% increased damage against Blighted Enemies.

Passively grants +40 Handling and automatically refills after being stowed for 2 seconds.

src.bungie: Blighted targets take damage over time and blight the nearby area on death.
src.clarity:
Direct Hits apply 'Blighted' to the target, dealing twice as much tick damage as Blighted Pools at half the rate for 9.5 seconds. Killing Blighted enemies causes them to drop a Blighted Pool.
Targets can only take damage from a single instance of Blighted at a time.
Enemies that are Blighted can take simultaneous damage from a Blighted Pool, and also take 25% increased damage from Malfeasance and Wish-Ender.
Blighted targets are STILL NOT CONSIDERED "TAKEN COMBATANTS".

src.bungie: Light attacks generate Sword energy and have the chance to spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites that heal the wielder upon attaching.
src.clarity:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.
Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.
Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.
Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.

Light Attacks deal 470 [377] Damage grant 30% Sword Energy and spawn 3 Quicksilver Nanites every 3 attacks or on kill.
Heavy Attacks, while having at least 10% Sword Energy, consume 3 Ammo to launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters forward, dealing 675 [301] Damage.

src.bungie: Quicksilver nanites that attach to the wielder charge the blade. [Alternate Weapon Action]  when fully charged to overclock the attached nanites, enhancing the blade's offensive capabilities. Light attacks deal increased damage to targets; fully charged Heavy attacks create a flaming Quicksilver swarm-nado.
src.clarity:
Every Nanite that attaches to you grants 4.5% progress to 'Nano-Assault'. Requires 21 Nanites to reach full charge.
Hold [Reload] at full Nano-Assault charge to enter 'Assault Mode'. Assault Mode immediately grants 14 ammo, 25% increased damage, and 30% Sword Energy per second for the duration of the buff. Stowing the blade during Assault Mode ends it and refunds 50% charge.
While Nano-Assault is active, Fully-Charged Heavy Attacks launch a solar wave that travels 13 meters and creates a 'Swarm-Nado' on impact. This detonates in a 7? meter radius with no damage falloff. Swarm-Nado deals ? damage in a 5 meter radius every 0.3 seconds for 3 seconds, and constantly generates ? nanites that return back to you.

src.bungie: [Heavy Attack]  : Use while sprinting with full energy to launch a heavy blink attack. Defeating a target with this attack allows it to be immediately used again.
src.clarity:
While at full Sword Energy, sprinting for 1 second grants 'Temporal Sprint' until you are no longer sprinting.
Performing a Grounded Heavy Attack with Temporal Sprint launches a teleporting Blink Attack, draining 50% Sword Energy and teleporting you 10 meters forward.
The Blink Attack consumes 3 ammo and deals up to 530 [353] damage 7 times to all enemies within 2 meters of the teleportation path.
Scoring a kill with this attack grants Temporal Sprint again for 2 seconds, and allows you to perform an additional Blink Attack that only costs 1 ammo and 10% sword energy.
src.compendium:
Arc Adaptive Sword
After sprinting for 1 second, while at 100% Sword Energy:
Grants Temporal Sprint until no longer sprinting.
Tesseract:
Grounded Powered Heavy Attack while Temporal Sprint is active launch a Heavy Blink Attack.
Heavy Blink Attacks drain 50% Sword Energy and consume 3 ammo.
Teleports the user 10 metres forward, dealing up to 530 [353] damage 7 times to enemies that are within 2 metres of the teleport path.
Scoring a Tesseract kill allows performing another Heavy Blink Attack within ? seconds that consume ? Ammo and drain 10% Sword Energy.
↑Another Dimension:
Temporal Sprint is granted after sprinting for 0.5 seconds.

src.bungie: Fires high-powered explosive ammunition.
src.clarity:
Fires high-caliber explosive rounds with a splash radius of 3 meters. Damage is split into two portions (18% Impact and 82% Explosive), with the explosion damage having no falloff.
Super Good Advice: Tap-Firing reduces Xenophage's Rate of Fire. Holding down the trigger is recommended.
src.compendium:
Solar Explosive Machine Gun
Fires Explosive Rounds that deal 262 [75?] Impact Damage and up to 898 [75?] Explosive Damage, down to 0% damage at 4.5 meters.
Recommended to hold down the trigger, as tapfiring reduces firerate.
This behavior is shared with most Automatic Weapons.
↑Catalyst: Grants the Chain Reaction and Rampage traits.

src.bungie: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.
src.clarity:
Aiming Down Sights grants the following benefits:
• 10 Range
• 10% increased Effective Zoom
• 5% increased Projectile Speed
The Effective Zoom increase pushes out Aim Assist Falloff by 10%, reduces (Absolute) Recoil by 10% and narrows the Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones by the same amount. (This is the normal behavior of Zoom and isn't unique to Rangefinder)
